meta.title: Modern Healthcare Data Platform
meta.subtitle: A Databricks-centered healthcare data platform microsite for an executive onsite conversation.
meta.sourceNote: Adapted from West Monroe Provider Data POV content and rewritten for executive presentation.

dataDomains.name: Clinical Data
dataDomains.summary: Encounters, diagnoses, procedures, orders, medications and results.

dataDomains.name: Operational Data
dataDomains.summary: Scheduling, throughput, capacity, referrals, utilization and staffing.

dataDomains.name: Financial Data
dataDomains.summary: Charges, claims, payments, contract, budget and revenue cycle detail.

dataDomains.name: Master Data
dataDomains.summary: Patient, provider, location, service line, payer and organization dimensions.

dataDomains.name: Documents / Images
dataDomains.summary: Scans, faxes, images, reports, transcripts and generated files.

platformServices.name: Certified Metrics
platformServices.description: Gold-layer definitions for core enterprise KPIs with lineage, ownership and quality rules.
platformServices.outcome: One definition of the truth for executives, finance, operations and clinical leaders.

platformServices.name: Forecast / Budget
platformServices.description: Standardized actuals, drivers and assumptions for budget, forecasting and scenarios.
platformServices.outcome: Connects historical performance, operating plans and forward-looking decisions.

platformServices.name: Transaction Detail
platformServices.description: Patient, encounter, claim, charge, payment and operational records for root-cause analysis.
platformServices.outcome: Lets leaders move from KPI variance to source detail without rebuilding datasets.

platformServices.name: Normalized Views
platformServices.description: Reusable views that harmonize source-system vocabulary across existing and acquired entities.
platformServices.outcome: Creates reusable building blocks for BI, analytics, apps, AI and reporting.

platformServices.name: Interop
platformServices.description: FHIR, HL7, APIs and partner-enabled patterns that connect the platform to the ecosystem.
platformServices.outcome: Enables movement between EHRs, partner tools, internal apps and downstream workflows.

platformServices.name: AI Features
platformServices.description: Curated feature tables, vectorized documents and model-ready signals governed through the platform.
platformServices.outcome: Turns clean data into reusable ingredients for predictive models and GenAI experiences.

foundationComponents.name: Core Application System Data
foundationComponents.summary: Ingest, normalize and cross-aggregate data from clinical, financial and operational systems so Parkview can analyze performance across the enterprise.
typicalScope: EHR and clinical suite, including scheduling, pharmacy, laboratory and ancillary systems
Financial management system, revenue cycle data and claims/payment detail
ERP, supply chain, HRIS and timekeeping data
Provider, patient, location, payer and organizational master data
benefits: Creates a shared language for consistent KPIs and enterprise metrics
Connects clinical, financial and operational context for root-cause analysis
Reduces duplicate extracts, report logic and reconciliation effort
Provides reusable data products for analytics, AI and downstream applications

foundationComponents.name: Streaming Data
foundationComponents.summary: Enable near-real-time data feeds for time-sensitive operational insight, workflow triggers and AI models that need current-state signals.
typicalScope: Redox-enabled ADT feeds, clinical alerts and payer integrations
Integration engine events and standards-based messages
Connected devices, IoT sensors and operational event streams
Real-time status changes for patient flow, capacity and discharge readiness
benefits: Creates a central connection hub for time-sensitive events
Enables proactive action on admissions, discharges, transfers and clinical alerts
Feeds operational command centers and in-workflow decision support
Improves model freshness where lagging batch data is insufficient

foundationComponents.name: Unstructured Data
foundationComponents.summary: Convert documents, images and machine-generated files into structured, searchable and AI-ready assets that enrich reporting and workflows.
typicalScope: Scanned documents, faxes and legacy content repositories
Clinical imaging metadata and radiology reports
Call transcripts, care-management notes and machine-generated files
Extracted entities, summarizations, embeddings and retrieval indexes
benefits: Reduces manual document review and information retrieval burden
Makes key facts available to reporting, analytics and AI tools
Enables content-aware routing, action triggers and care continuity workflows
Builds a foundation for clinical knowledge search and GenAI assistants

analytics.name: Rapid Insights
analytics.summary: Give business and clinical leaders right-fit access to trusted data through modern BI, AI-assisted exploration and embedded applications.
analytics.role: Primary executive and manager-facing experience layer

analytics.name: Predictive Analytics
analytics.summary: Use curated features and governed data to forecast outcomes, anticipate constraints and guide operational decisions.

analytics.name: AI and Workflow
analytics.summary: Operationalize trusted data in applications, agents and workflow surfaces that reduce friction and accelerate action.
analytics.role: Action layer for apps, agents and workflow automation

useCases.name: Post-Acquisition Data Integration Hub
useCases.description: Integrate acquired health-system data and inaccessible financial data into Databricks, standardize key data elements and publish certified metrics for analysis in Sigma.
useCases.timeline: Phased pilot, then reusable acquisition pattern
quantitativeBenefits: Days from data-source access to executive KPI availability
Manual extracts, spreadsheets and duplicate reports retired
Data-quality defects discovered, remediated and monitored
Priority metrics with certified definitions and lineage
qualitativeBenefits: Faster leadership visibility after acquisition close
Consistent definitions across acquired and existing entities
Confidence in financial, operational and regulatory reporting
useCases.demo: Reserve this space for a Sigma dashboard, architecture walk-through or short video that shows acquisition data moving from source systems into certified metrics.

useCases.name: Sigma AI Business Intelligence
useCases.description: Use Sigma on top of governed Databricks data products to give executives and analysts a spreadsheet-familiar BI experience with governed metrics and AI-assisted exploration.
useCases.demo: Demo a finance or operational workbook that drills from a leadership metric into transaction detail.

useCases.name: Redox ADT Integration
useCases.description: Stream admissions, discharges and transfers through Redox into the healthcare data platform to support operational visibility and downstream workflow triggers.
quantitativeBenefits: Coverage of facilities and ADT event types
qualitativeBenefits: Reduced reliance on lagging daily reports
Stronger foundation for command-center use cases
useCases.demo: Show a live-style ADT event moving into the platform and updating a patient-flow queue.

useCases.name: Continuity of Care Document Processing
useCases.description: Extract clinically relevant facts from scanned and faxed continuity-of-care documents and make them searchable, routable and available to analytics and AI workflows.
qualitativeBenefits: Better patient context for downstream tools
useCases.demo: Show a document summary, extracted fields and the downstream queue or search experience.

useCases.name: Clinical Command Center
useCases.description: Combine current operational events, clinical data and forecasts to support enterprise visibility into patient flow, capacity and prioritized interventions.
useCases.demo: Optional future-state visualization with alert tiles, census trends and action queues.

useCases.name: Clinician Scheduling Optimization
useCases.description: Use demand, availability, service line patterns and staffing data to improve schedule alignment and reduce manual planning effort.
useCases.demo: Show scenario planning for clinic capacity and staffing options.

useCases.name: Supply Chain Optimization
useCases.description: Connect clinical demand, inventory, ERP and purchasing data to improve spend visibility, forecast utilization and reduce operational waste.
qualitativeBenefits: Improved coordination across finance, supply chain and operations
useCases.demo: Show spend and utilization dashboard with drill-through to item-level detail.

useCases.name: Patient Engagement Chatbot
useCases.description: Ground patient-facing or team-facing AI assistants in trusted Parkview content, operational data and workflow context.
useCases.timeline: Governed AI pilot after data foundation maturity
qualitativeBenefits: Better handoff to staff when human review is needed
useCases.demo: Show a governed Q&A flow with citations to approved content and escalation guardrails.

narrativePillars.name: Operational Efficiency

narrativePillars.name: Financial Performance

narrativePillars.name: Compliance and Trust

narrativePillars.copy: A data and AI-ready architecture makes new use cases easier to launch and govern.
